Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ShunnedOne wrote:
> 1. Why are the two US championship events at gencon scheduled for Friday and
> Saturday instead of Saturday and Sunday which was the way it was done in the
> past?

To avoid having finalists forced to bow out in order to catch a plane (and
otherwise avoid the mad crunch that occurs on Sunday).

> 2. Is the constructed portion of the championship considered a qualifer for
> the NAC?

No.
